value.title: Part 2
value.synopsis: The long-awaited assembly of all nine Azur Lane factions is approaching. However, during the meeting of the factions' representatives, a consensus for the theme is reached in the absence of Royal Navy's Queen Elizabeth and Iris Libre's Richelieu. As a result, no space is left for either faction to construct their stall on the event grounds. To ensure that the international gathering is a success, Queen Elizabeth takes it upon herself to convince the other factions to compromise for the sake of their beloved commander.
